summary: publish_plan_ready.py CLI requires repository root, plan dir, output; loads validation/state/resume artifacts and appends report; rejects unless validation predicate=plan-valid, status=pass, authorizes=[]; permits only draft or plan-ready lifecycle; draft transitions state to plan-ready with authorizes=[plan-ready], owner=vdd; updates resume status=plan-ready and next_action=awaiting-maintainer-implementation-authorization; report records explicitly non-authorizing publication; emits schema toolchain-workflow-repair.plan-ready-publication.v1 receipt with hashes of validation/state/resume; receipt authorizes only plan-ready; expressly excludes implementation-authorized, implementation-complete, acceptance-passed, knowledge-publication, bootstrap-review; creates output parent and prints pass JSON.
